text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- European Fisheries Commissioner Bonino says Morocco has sovereignty over its waters so renewal of fish accord with EU only depends on its decision.
- Crown Prince Mohamed presides over opening of sacred music world festival in central city of Fez.
- Bonino considers new fish accord with Morocco ahead of the two-day seminar on fish industries partnership to be held in Casablanca starting Monday.
- Two Moroccan tennis players to take part in France's Roland Garros tournament.
- National commission in charge of elections follow-up holds meeting on internal legislation and use of media.
- Morocco should open social offices in transiting points to ease procedures for expatriates returning home for summer.
